summary: The first-round UI issues are fixed and responsive overflow was not observed at 320px, 390px, or desktop. Two approved design-contract mismatches remain in the ToolCall summary and preview language metadata.

open_findings.trigger: Initial ToolCall summary render across 1280px, 390px and 320px.
open_findings.impact: Completion is plain 12px text in a bordered summary, diverging from the borderless ToolCall and shared 24px StatusBadge contract (`확인 완료`). The extra box competes with the result preview border.
open_findings.correction: Use the shared success StatusBadge contract and remove the ToolCall summary border; retain a boundary only for the result detail.

open_findings.impact: The article declares `lang=en-US` while the title and description are Korean, which may cause wrong pronunciation for assistive technology.
open_findings.correction: Set this fixture locale to `ko-KR` and let previews without a content locale inherit the document language.

limits: Static synthetic fixture only. Live streaming, permission cards, dark mode, 200% zoom, screen-reader output and real SDK behavior remain unverified.
